meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在需要为多品类商品创作或优化营销图片文案时使用。自动提炼核心卖点，生成带emoji的吸睛标题与直击痛点的场景化正文，一键产出高转化率电商文案，省时省力大幅提升商品点击与购买转化！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼商品卖点，生成带表情的吸睛营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要为电商商品撰写吸引人的标题和描述
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling product copy from key selling points
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write product titles and descriptions for online stores

howto.what: 装上后,你提供产品名称、卖点、目标用户,Claude 就按电商模板产出图片文案:带 emoji 的标题加四段正文(痛点、产品介绍、2-3 个卖点、情感召唤);也能优化已有文案,输出 Markdown。
howto.when: 当你提出电商文案创作或文案优化需求时接管;覆盖智能家居、数码配件、环保生活等多品类商品。

say.text: 帮我给智能睡眠眼罩写一条电商文案,卖点是科学遮光和智能感应光线
say.note: 先收集产品信息,再输出 Markdown 文案

say.text: 这条充电宝文案的标题太平淡,帮我加上 emoji 和产品昵称重写
say.note: 先分析原文案,再给出优化后的标题与正文

say.text: 给环保可降解餐具套装写标题和四段正文,目标用户是年轻妈妈
say.note: 按环保生活类模板生成

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns the product name, selling points and target user you give it into e-commerce image copy: an emoji headline plus a four-part body (pain point, product intro, 2-3 selling points, emotional call to action). It can also optimize existing copy, output in Markdown.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask for e-commerce copy creation or optimization, covering product types such as smart home, digital accessories and eco-friendly living.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce copy for a smart sleep mask, key selling points: smart shading.
say_en.note: It collects product details, then outputs Markdown copy.

say_en.text: Rewrite my power bank copy headline with an emoji and a product nickname.
say_en.note: It reviews the copy, then returns an optimized version.

say_en.text: Write a headline and four-part body for eco-friendly tableware for young moms.
